sources.quote: Torino Plant 3 (TO3) is not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0208: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese)

findings.why: Alluminio B's approvals for BR-180 (AP-0208 for STL, AP-0212 for CLM) are for receiving plant TO1 only. Approval is per part, plant and customer, and TO3 is outside the ASL scope. No controlled record covers BR-180 at TO3 for STL. Absence of a record cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm whether a controlled approval exists for TO3 before the pilot builds.
